name: voltage
description: Calculates downstream voltage distribution for selected nodes.

requirements.description: This plugin calculates the voltage distribution and timeseries profile for a selected asset and its neighbors (by degree).
agent_directives: Use this plugin when the user asks for 'voltage', 'power quality', or 'voltage profile' around an asset.
Expect a distribution histogram (KDE), a loading-vs-voltage scatter plot, and a statistical timeseries.
Ask the user for 'degrees' if they want to expand the traversal depth (default 5).
